UPDATE meetings m SET transcript = n.transcript,
                  transcript_source = COALESCE(m.transcript_source, 'provider:clovanote')
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (meeting_id) meeting_id, transcript
              FROM clovanote_notes WHERE meeting_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(COALESCE(transcript,'')) <> ''
              ORDER BY meeting_id, transcript_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, synced_at DESC, id) n
        WHERE m.id=n.meeting_id AND btrim(COALESCE(m.transcript,'')) = ''
INSERT INTO ops_event_receipts (dedupe_key) SELECT dedupe_key FROM ops_events WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO google_accounts
            (account_id, state, message, last_error_code, last_ok_at, last_checked_at, reauth_notified_at,
             created_at, updated_at)
        SELECT account_id,
               CASE
                   WHEN state = 'reauth_required' THEN 'reauth_required'
                   WHEN state = 'session_saved' THEN 'session_saved'
                   WHEN state IN ('ready', 'cooldown', 'blocked') AND last_ok_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ready'
                   WHEN state IN ('ready', 'cooldown', 'blocked') THEN 'session_saved'
                   ELSE 'login_required'
               END,
               CASE WHEN state IN ('reauth_required', 'session_saved', 'login_required') THEN message ELSE NULL END,
               CASE WHEN state = 'reauth_required' THEN last_error_code ELSE NULL END,
               last_ok_at, last_checked_at, reauth_notified_at, created_at, updated_at
        FROM notebooklm_accounts
        ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING
CREATE TRIGGER kb_evidence_validate BEFORE INSERT ON kb_evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kb_validate_evidence_span()

CREATE TABLE research_studies (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	goal TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	environment JSONB NOT NULL, 
	criteria JSONB NOT NULL, 
	next_actions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_research_scope CHECK (scope in ('personal','work'))
)

CREATE TABLE research_nodes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	study_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	conditions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	details JSONB NOT NULL, 
	epistemic_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_id UUID, 
	supersedes_id UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(study_id) REFERENCES research_studies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_id) REFERENCES kb_evidence (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_id) REFERENCES research_nodes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_relations (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	study_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	from_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	to_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	predicate VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT NOT NULL, 
	conditions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(study_id) REFERENCES research_studies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(from_id) REFERENCES research_nodes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(to_id) REFERENCES research_nodes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_experiments (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	study_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	hypothesis TEXT NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT NOT NULL, 
	adapter VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	config JSONB NOT NULL, 
	environment JSONB NOT NULL, 
	budget JSONB NOT NULL, 
	receipt JSONB NOT NULL, 
	method_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_research_execution_state CHECK (state in ('queued','running','paused','blocked','completed','failed','cancelled','needs_verification')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(study_id) REFERENCES research_studies (id)
)

CREATE TABLE research_events (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	study_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(study_id) REFERENCES research_studies (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER research_nodes_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON research_nodes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION research_immutable_row()
CREATE TRIGGER research_relations_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON research_relations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION research_immutable_row()
CREATE TRIGGER research_events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON research_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION research_immutable_row()
CREATE TRIGGER research_relation_validate BEFORE INSERT ON research_relations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION research_validate_relation()
CREATE TRIGGER research_node_validate BEFORE INSERT ON research_nodes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION research_validate_node()
CREATE TRIGGER kb_revisions_validate BEFORE INSERT ON kb_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kb_validate_revision()
CREATE TRIGGER kb_passages_validate BEFORE INSERT ON kb_passages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION kb_validate_passage()

CREATE TABLE collector_sources (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	request JSONB NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	auto_import BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	interval_minutes INTEGER, 
	next_run_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_job_id UUID, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error VARCHAR(500), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_collector_sources_identity UNIQUE (tenant_id, scope, source_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_sources_scope CHECK (scope IN ('personal', 'work')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_sources_interval CHECK (interval_minutes IS NULL OR interval_minutes >= 15), 
	FOREIGN KEY(last_job_id) REFERENCES collector_jobs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE kb_document_access (
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_kb_document_access_scope CHECK (scope IN ('personal', 'work')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES kb_documents (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE kb_observations (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	envelope_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	provenance JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_kb_observations_envelope UNIQUE (envelope_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES kb_documents (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES kb_revisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE collector_deliveries (
	outbox_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	item_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision_id UUID, 
	outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (outbox_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(outbox_id) REFERENCES collector_outbox (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES collector_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES kb_revisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE collector_daily_budgets (
	day VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_pages INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (day)
)

CREATE TABLE collector_reviews (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	item_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	text_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES collector_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE collector_quality_models (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	artifact JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE kb_passage_vectors (
	passage_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	model_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	text_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	vector VECTOR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (passage_id, model_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(passage_id) REFERENCES kb_passages (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collector_evidence_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector evidence is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
CREATE TRIGGER kb_observations_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON kb_observations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_evidence_immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER collector_reviews_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON collector_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_evidence_immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER collector_quality_models_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON collector_quality_models FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_evidence_immutable()

CREATE TABLE collector_budget_buckets (
	kind VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	limit_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	limit_calls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	limit_micro_usd BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_calls INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_micro_usd BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (kind, key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_budget_buckets_kind CHECK (kind IN ('day', 'job')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_budget_buckets_nonneg CHECK (reserved_tokens >= 0 AND reserved_calls >= 0 AND reserved_micro_usd >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE collector_budget_reservations (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	day VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64), 
	purpose VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	engine VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reserved_micro_usd BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	charged_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	charged_micro_usd BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	receipt JSONB, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	settled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_collector_budget_reservations_key UNIQUE (request_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_budget_reservations_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved', 'settled', 'unknown'))
)

CREATE TABLE collector_cache (
	cache_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(200), 
	hits INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (cache_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collector_cache_kind CHECK (kind IN ('positive', 'negative', 'unknown'))
)

CREATE TABLE collector_runtime_flags (
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name)
)
